authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1340.2 *ālla explicitly gives Bashkarik āl wet and neighboring ālo. Bashkarik ālū selects this contracted lateral wet family with the final vowel retained. Exact survey form ālū is preserved.

assignments.Notes: CDIAL 1340.2 *ālla explicitly gives Bashkarik āl wet and neighboring ālo. Bashkarik ālū selects this contracted lateral wet family with the final vowel retained. Exact survey form ālū is preserved. Joint SIL review 2026-09-14.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13139 sapta explicitly gives Bashkarik sat and Torwali sāt seven. Survey sāʔt/sātʔ fits this numeral, with glottal articulation preserved rather than interpreted as an extra morpheme. Exact survey form sāʔt is preserved.
